versos.hebraico: וַיְצַ֤ו מֹשֶׁה֙ וְזִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר שָׁמֹר֙ אֶת־כָּל־הַמִּצְוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם הַיּֽוֹם׃

controles.web: Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, “Keep all the commandment which I command you this day.
controles.kjv: And Moses with the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, Keep all the commandments which I command you this day.
controles.livre: E mandou Moisés, com os anciãos de Israel, ao povo, dizendo: Guardareis todos os mandamentos que eu prescrevo hoje.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֗ה בַּיּוֹם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעַבְר֣וּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן֒ אֶל־הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֣ן לָ֑ךְ וַהֲקֵמֹתָ֤ לְךָ֙ אֲבָנִ֣ים גְּדֹל֔וֹת וְשַׂדְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם בַּשִּֽׂיד׃

controles.web: It shall be on the day when you shall pass over the Jordan to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, that you shall set yourself up great stones, and coat them with plaster.
controles.kjv: And it shall be on the day when ye shall pass over Jordan unto the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee, that thou shalt set thee up great stones, and plaister them with plaister:
controles.livre: E será que, no dia que passardes o Jordão à terra que o SENHOR teu Deus te dá, te hás de levantar pedras grandes, as quais rebocarás com cal:

versos.hebraico: וְכָתַבְתָּ֣ עֲלֵיהֶ֗ן אֶֽת־כָּל־דִּבְרֵ֛י הַתּוֹרָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את בְּעָבְרֶ֑ךָ לְמַ֡עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ תָּבֹ֨א אֶל־הָאָ֜רֶץ אֲֽשֶׁר־יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֣יךָ׀ נֹתֵ֣ן לְךָ֗ אֶ֣רֶץ זָבַ֤ת חָלָב֙ וּדְבַ֔שׁ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־אֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ לָֽךְ׃

controles.web: You shall write on them all the words of this law, when you have passed over; that you may go in to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, a land flowing with milk and honey, as Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has promised you.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt write upon them all the words of this law, when thou art passed over, that thou mayest go in unto the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee, a land that floweth with milk and honey; as the Lord God of thy fathers hath promised thee.
controles.livre: E escreverás nelas todas as palavras desta lei, quando houveres passado para entrar na terra que o SENHOR teu Deus te dá, terra que flui leite e mel, como o SENHOR o Deus de teus pais te disse.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָה֮ בְּעָבְרְכֶ֣ם אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן֒ תָּקִ֜ימוּ אֶת־הָאֲבָנִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֜י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֛ם הַיּ֖וֹם בְּהַ֣ר עֵיבָ֑ל וְשַׂדְתָּ֥ אוֹתָ֖ם בַּשִּֽׂיד׃

controles.web: It shall be, when you have passed over the Jordan, that you shall set up these stones, which I command you this day, on Mount Ebal, and you shall coat them with plaster.
controles.kjv: Therefore it shall be when ye be gone over Jordan, that ye shall set up these stones, which I command you this day, in mount Ebal, and thou shalt plaister them with plaister.
controles.livre: Será pois, quando houveres passado o Jordão, que levantareis estas pedras que eu vos mando hoje, no monte de Ebal, e as rebocarás com cal:

versos.hebraico: וּבָנִ֤יתָ שָּׁם֙ מִזְבֵּ֔חַ לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ מִזְבַּ֣ח אֲבָנִ֔ים לֹא־תָנִ֥יף עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם בַּרְזֶֽל׃

controles.web: There you shall build an altar to Yahweh your God, an altar of stones. You shall not use any iron tool on them.
controles.kjv: And there shalt thou build an altar unto the Lord thy God, an altar of stones: thou shalt not lift up any iron tool upon them.
controles.livre: E edificarás ali altar ao SENHOR teu Deus, altar de pedras: não levantarás sobre elas ferro.

versos.hebraico: אֲבָנִ֤ים שְׁלֵמוֹת֙ תִּבְנֶ֔ה אֶת־מִזְבַּ֖ח יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וְהַעֲלִ֤יתָ עָלָיו֙ עוֹלֹ֔ת לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: You shall build the altar of Yahweh your God of uncut stones. You shall offer burnt offerings on it to Yahweh your God.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt build the altar of the Lord thy God of whole stones: and thou shalt offer burnt offerings thereon unto the Lord thy God:
controles.livre: De pedras inteiras edificarás o altar do SENHOR teu Deus; e oferecerás sobre ele holocausto ao SENHOR teu Deus;

versos.hebraico: וְזָבַחְתָּ֥ שְׁלָמִ֖ים וְאָכַ֣לְתָּ שָּׁ֑ם וְשָׂ֣מַחְתָּ֔ לִפְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: You shall sacrifice peace offerings, and shall eat there. You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt offer peace offerings, and shalt eat there, and rejoice before the Lord thy God.
controles.livre: E sacrificarás ofertas pacíficas, e comerás ali; e te alegrarás diante do SENHOR teu Deus.

versos.hebraico: וְכָתַבְתָּ֣ עַל־הָאֲבָנִ֗ים אֶֽת־כָּל־דִּבְרֵ֛י הַתּוֹרָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את בַּאֵ֥ר הֵיטֵֽב׃ס

controles.web: You shall write on the stones all the words of this law very plainly.”
controles.kjv: And thou shalt write upon the stones all the words of this law very plainly.
controles.livre: E escreverás nas pedras todas as palavras desta lei muito claramente.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים הַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֶ֥ל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר הַסְכֵּ֤ת׀ וּשְׁמַע֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַיּ֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ נִהְיֵ֣יתָֽ לְעָ֔ם לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: Moses and the priests the Levites spoke to all Israel, saying, “Be silence, and listen, Israel! Today you have become the people of Yahweh your God.
controles.kjv: And Moses and the priests the Levites spake unto all Israel, saying, Take heed, and hearken, O Israel; this day thou art become the people of the Lord thy God.
controles.livre: E Moisés, com os sacerdotes levitas, falou a todo Israel, dizendo: Atende e escuta, Israel: hoje és feito povo do SENHOR teu Deus.

versos.hebraico: וְשָׁ֣מַעְתָּ֔ בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ אֶת־מִצְוֺתָו֙ וְאֶת־חֻקָּ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּֽוֹם׃ס

controles.web: You shall therefore obey Yahweh your God’s voice, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command you this day.”
controles.kjv: Thou shalt therefore obey the voice of the Lord thy God, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command thee this day.
controles.livre: Ouvirás, pois, a voz do SENHOR teu Deus, e cumprirás seus mandamentos e seus estatutos, que eu te ordeno hoje.

versos.hebraico: וַיְצַ֤ו מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־הָעָ֔ם בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Moses commanded the people the same day, saying,
controles.kjv: And Moses charged the people the same day, saying,
controles.livre: E mandou Moisés ao povo naquele dia, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: אֵ֠לֶּה יַֽעַמְד֞וּ לְבָרֵ֤ךְ אֶת־הָעָם֙ עַל־הַ֣ר גְּרִזִ֔ים בְּעָבְרְכֶ֖ם אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן שִׁמְעוֹן֙ וְלֵוִ֣י וִֽיהוּדָ֔ה וְיִשָּׂשכָ֖ר וְיוֹסֵ֥ף וּבִנְיָמִֽן׃

controles.web: “These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people, when you have passed over the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
controles.kjv: These shall stand upon mount Gerizim to bless the people, when ye are come over Jordan; Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin:
controles.livre: Estes estarão sobre o monte de Gerizim para abençoar ao povo, quando houverdes passado o Jordão: Simeão, e Levi, e Judá, e Issacar, e José e Benjamim.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֛לֶּה יַֽעַמְד֥וּ עַל־הַקְּלָלָ֖ה בְּהַ֣ר עֵיבָ֑ל רְאוּבֵן֙ גָּ֣ד וְאָשֵׁ֔ר וּזְבוּלֻ֖ן דָּ֥ן וְנַפְתָּלִֽי׃

controles.web: These shall stand on Mount Ebal for the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
controles.kjv: And these shall stand upon mount Ebal to curse; Reuben, Gad, and Asher, and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
controles.livre: E estes estarão para pronunciar a maldição no de Ebal: Rúben, Gade, e Aser, e Zebulom, Dã, e Naftali.

versos.hebraico: וְעָנ֣וּ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם וְאָֽמְר֛וּ אֶל־כָּל־אִ֥ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל ק֥וֹל רָֽם׃ס

controles.web: With a loud voice, the Levites shall say to all the men of Israel,
controles.kjv: And the Levites shall speak, and say unto all the men of Israel with a loud voice,
controles.livre: E falarão os levitas, e dirão a todo homem de Israel em alta voz:

versos.hebraico: אָר֣וּר הָאִ֡ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַעֲשֶׂה֩ פֶ֨סֶל וּמַסֵּכָ֜ה תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה מַעֲשֵׂ֛ה יְדֵ֥י חָרָ֖שׁ וְשָׂ֣ם בַּסָּ֑תֶר וְעָנ֧וּ כָל־הָעָ֛ם וְאָמְר֖וּ אָמֵֽן׃ס

controles.web: ‘Cursed is the man who makes an engraved or molten image, an abomination to Yahweh, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and sets it up in secret.’   All the people shall answer and say, ‘Amen.’
controles.kjv: Cursed be the man that maketh any graven or molten image, an abomination unto the Lord, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and putteth it in a secret place. And all the people shall answer and say, Amen.
controles.livre: Maldito o homem que fizer escultura ou imagem de fundição, abominação ao SENHOR, obra da mão de artífice, e a puser em oculto. E todo o povo responderá e dirá: Amém.

versos.hebraico: אָר֕וּר מַקְלֶ֥ה אָבִ֖יו וְאִמּ֑וֹ וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס

controles.web: ‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or his mother.’   All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
controles.kjv: Cursed be he that setteth light by his father or his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.
controles.livre: Maldito o que desonrar a seu pai ou a sua mãe. E dirá todo o povo: Amém.

versos.hebraico: אָר֕וּר מַסִּ֖יג גְּב֣וּל רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס

controles.web: ‘Cursed is he who removes his neighbor’s landmark.’   All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
controles.kjv: Cursed be he that removeth his neighbour’s landmark. And all the people shall say, Amen.
controles.livre: Maldito o que reduzir o termo de seu próximo. E dirá todo o povo: Amém.

versos.hebraico: אָר֕וּר מַשְׁגֶּ֥ה עִוֵּ֖ר בַּדָּ֑רֶךְ וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס

controles.web: ‘Cursed is he who leads the blind astray on the road.’     All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
controles.kjv: Cursed be he that maketh the blind to wander out of the way. And all the people shall say, Amen.
controles.livre: Maldito o que fizer errar ao cego no caminho. E dirá todo o povo: Amém.

versos.hebraico: אָר֗וּר מַטֶּ֛ה מִשְׁפַּ֥ט גֵּר־יָת֖וֹם וְאַלְמָנָ֑ה וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס

controles.web: ‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, fatherless, and widow.’   All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
controles.kjv: Cursed be he that perverteth the judgment of the stranger, fatherless, and widow. And all the people shall say, Amen.
controles.livre: Maldito o que distorcer o direito do estrangeiro, do órfão, e da viúva. E dirá todo o povo: Amém.

versos.hebraico: אָר֗וּר שֹׁכֵב֙ עִם־אֵ֣שֶׁת אָבִ֔יו כִּ֥י גִלָּ֖ה כְּנַ֣ף אָבִ֑יו וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס

controles.web: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his father’s wife, because he dishonors his father’s bed.’   All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
controles.kjv: Cursed be he that lieth with his father’s wife; because he uncovereth his father’s skirt. And all the people shall say, Amen.
controles.livre: Maldito o que se deitar com a mulher de seu pai; porquanto revelou o colo de seu pai. E dirá todo o povo: Amém.

versos.hebraico: אָר֕וּר שֹׁכֵ֖ב עִם־כָּל־בְּהֵמָ֑ה וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס

controles.web: ‘Cursed is he who lies with any kind of animal.’   All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
controles.kjv: Cursed be he that lieth with any manner of beast. And all the people shall say, Amen.
controles.livre: Maldito o que tiver parte com qualquer animal. E dirá todo o povo: Amém.

versos.hebraico: אָר֗וּר שֹׁכֵב֙ עִם־אֲחֹת֔וֹ בַּת־אָבִ֖יו א֣וֹ בַת־אִמּ֑וֹ וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס

controles.web: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his sister, his father’s daughter or his mother’s daughter.’   All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
controles.kjv: Cursed be he that lieth with his sister, the daughter of his father, or the daughter of his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.
controles.livre: Maldito o que se deitar com sua irmã, filha de seu pai, ou filha de sua mãe. E dirá todo o povo: Amém.

versos.hebraico: אָר֕וּר שֹׁכֵ֖ב עִם־חֹֽתַנְתּ֑וֹ וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס

controles.web: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his mother-in-law.’   All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
controles.kjv: Cursed be he that lieth with his mother in law. And all the people shall say, Amen.
controles.livre: Maldito o que se deitar com sua sogra. E dirá todo o povo: Amém.

versos.hebraico: אָר֕וּר מַכֵּ֥ה רֵעֵ֖הוּ בַּסָּ֑תֶר וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס

controles.web: ‘Cursed is he who secretly kills his neighbor.’   All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
controles.kjv: Cursed be he that smiteth his neighbour secretly. And all the people shall say, Amen.
controles.livre: Maldito o que ferir a seu próximo ocultamente. E dirá todo o povo: Amém.

versos.hebraico: אָרוּר֙ לֹקֵ֣חַ שֹׁ֔חַד לְהַכּ֥וֹת נֶ֖פֶשׁ דָּ֣ם נָקִ֑י וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס

controles.web: ‘Cursed is he who takes a bribe to kill an innocent person.’   All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
controles.kjv: Cursed be he that taketh reward to slay an innocent person. And all the people shall say, Amen.
controles.livre: Maldito o que receber presente para ferir de morte ao inocente. E dirá todo o povo: Amém.

versos.hebraico: אָר֗וּר אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹא־יָקִ֛ים אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֥י הַתּוֹרָֽה־הַזֹּ֖את לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת אוֹתָ֑ם וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃פ

controles.web: ‘Cursed is he who doesn’t uphold the words of this law by doing them.’   All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’”
controles.kjv: Cursed be he that confirmeth not all the words of this law to do them. And all the people shall say, Amen.
controles.livre: Maldito o que não confirmar as palavras desta lei para as cumprir. E dirá todo o povo: Amém.
